items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: Him and old man Doc Moniz. And who was it? Galon Dufres.

ctx.x: There was a lot of music up there.

Oh, indeed he was. He was one of the best we ever had. Him and old man Doc Moniz. And who was it? Galon Dufres. Doc Monique, his name. Doc Monique. Doc Monique. Doc Monique. What genus fruit did you find?
